Subject: Northspin SIG questionnaire and evidence asks (deadline 2026-07-07)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG questionnaire export (Northspin_SIG_2026.xlsx). We need a couple of clarifications before our security intake:

- Control mapping: for items referencing KMS, ephemeral key rotation, and hybrid private deployments, we ask for an explicit mapping to SIG controls (names/IDs) and one or two representative artifacts per control.
- Evidence samples: we accept redacted logs or sample artifacts showing key rotation events, telemetry sampling, and data classification tags for Private deployments.
- Deployment model: we need confirmation whether the Private (VPC) stack uses customer KMS or Redwood-managed keys in mixed-mode (and what proofs you can provide).

Deadline: our procurement window closes 2026-07-07; can you provide a draft mapping and at least two sample artifacts by 2026-06-18 so we can review?

Attachments: Northspin_SIG_2026.xlsx (questionnaire)

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor

Subject: Re: Northspin SIG questionnaire and evidence asks (deadline 2026-07-07)

Hi Aditya — appreciate the plan. A few clarifications and requests: 

- Evidence format: PDF or text excerpts are fine; for logs we prefer a 1-2 hour slice with timestamps in ISO and a short README explaining the events used as proof.
- KMS ownership: we need explicit examples for both models if you support both. If Redwood-managed keys are used for Private, we need key custody diagram and proof of rotation (signed event or audit entry).
- Telemetry: a sample that shows token-level latency/cost aggregation is sufficient — redaction is expected.

Secure upload: please use our SFTP (sftp.northspin.com:/incoming/redwood). I'll open an inbound folder and provide credentials once you confirm.

Also: legal will want a short statement that the provided artifacts are genuine extracts of production telemetry and not synthetic; if you can't state that for a sample, call it "representative synthetic sample". That distinction affects our procurement acceptance.

Thanks,
Liam

Liam — we uploaded the initial drafts to your SFTP and left a short manifest in the folder. Summary of what you will find: 

- /incoming/redwood/manifest.txt (summary + README)
- redwood_kms_rotation_sample.txt (redacted rotation audit entries; timestamps; key-ids masked, event hashes preserved)
- redwood_telemetry_sample.json (1-hour telemetry slice; token-latency aggregates; redacted request ids)
- sig_control_mapping_draft.xlsx (control mapping; suggested evidence filenames; owner for collection)
- redwood_private_arch_diagram_v1.pdf (logical deployment diagram: control-plane vs data-plane; KMS options annotated)

Notes: 
- The KMS rotation artifact is a redacted extract from our audit trail (redaction removes customer-specific key identifiers). Kimberly reviewed and confirmed no customer secrets are included.
- The telemetry sample is a representative production slice (we mark it as "representative production extract" in the manifest); if you need an officially notarized statement we can route through legal (Jordan).

Jordan — can you draft a short attestation paragraph we can append to the manifest stating the origin and redaction level? That will expedite procurement.

Liam — let me know once you verify receipt on SFTP and whether the content meets the control mapping expectation. If anything needs to be adjusted we can do a fast follow.

Best,
